title: E2E Test Scenarios
description: End-to-end GraphQL booking test scenarios. Add new tests by adding entries to the scenarios array.

scenarios.description: List of test scenarios to execute.

testName.description: Unique name for this test scenario — shown in the test runner output.

multiCityLocations.description: Airport codes for multi-city journeys (pairs of origin/destination for each slice). Required when journeyType is MultiCity.

inboundFlightType.description: Optional airline for the inbound sector of a return journey.

validateChildMealRemarks.description: Poll the downstream PNR and verify OrderMgmt eventing stamps allocated CHML remarks for child passengers.

bookingType.description: Revenue = standard purchase, Redemption = points-only award, PayWithPoints = part cash + part points.

loyaltyTierCode.description: Flying Club tier for redemption/PWP/CoBrand scenarios.

minLoyaltyPoints.description: Minimum points the loyalty account must have.

cardNumber.description: Card number for payment. Only used when paymentMethod is Card or ThreeDS.

is3DS.description: Whether the card requires 3D Secure authentication.

usePlaywrightForHpp.description: Runs supported direct hosted-payment-page card, PayPal, or 3DS interaction through Playwright instead of Selenium. Co-brand support remains experimental and is not enabled in regression data.

paymentCountry.description: Billing country for the card payment.

state.description: Billing state (required for US billing addresses).

postcode.description: Billing postcode/zip. If omitted, defaults are applied from paymentCountry/state.

paymentCardType.description: Specific card type enum for insurance scenarios.

seatMode.description: None = no seat selection, OneWay = select seats for outbound only, AllSectors = select for all sectors, ClearDown = select then verify seats clear on basket update.

seatProductName.description: Seat product to select. Required when seatMode is not None.

cabinName.description: Cabin code for seat selection. Required when seatMode is not None.

insurance.description: None = skip insurance, Accept = quote and accept, Reject = quote and reject.

isCoBrand.description: Whether this is a Synchrony co-brand card scenario.

coBrandLastName.description: Last name for the co-brand application. Required when isCoBrand is true.

coBrandFirstName.description: First name for the co-brand application. Required when isCoBrand is true.

synchronyApplicationStatus.description: Expected Synchrony application decision. Required when isCoBrand is true.

isRewardSearch.description: Whether the search should use the reward/award flag.

flyingClubPassenger.description: Whether the passenger is a Flying Club member (for seat + loyalty scenarios).

isLoggedIn.description: Whether to authenticate a Flying Club test member before a revenue booking search.

flyingClubTier.description: Flying Club tier when flyingClubPassenger is true.

expectFraudCheck.description: Whether the order is expected to trigger a fraud check (e.g. near departure date + high-risk country).

useNearDepartureDate.description: Set departure date to tomorrow instead of the normal future date.

departureDate.description: Optional fixed departure date in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss format for route-specific availability checks.

isMultiCity.description: Whether this is a multi-city search (uses multiCityLocations instead of origin/destination).

categories.description: Test trait categories for filtering in the test runner.

useExplicitSearchOverload.description: Use the explicit OfferSearchGraphQL overload with individual parameters instead of TestConfig.

randomOffer.description: Whether to pick a random offer from search results.

requiredLegOperatingAirlineCode.description: Optional leg-level operating airline code that selected offers must contain.

validateInsurancePriceWithPaymentMS.description: Validate insurance price against the payment microservice response.

validateInsuranceInOrderDoc.description: Validate accepted insurance in the PNR order document.

validateRejectedInsuranceInOrderDoc.description: Validate rejected insurance flag in the PNR order document.

useSynchronyCardPayment.description: Use Synchrony card details on the HPP payment page.

fullPointsSelection.description: Select full points amount in pay-with-points converter.

hasPaidSeat.description: Include a paid seat selection (for insurance + seat combo tests).

hasFreeSeat.description: Include a free seat selection (for insurance + seat combo tests).

useRetryHelperForLoyalty.description: Use the retry helper when retrieving loyalty account details.

writeToAzure.description: Write PNR to Azure storage table after order creation.

validateRedemptionBasket.description: Run the full redemption basket validation (membership points, FC details, flight price).

validatePaymentRetreive.description: Validate payment retrieve response against basket totals.

validateVoucherConfirmation.description: Apply a voucher and validate its settled state through Order Create confirmation.

voucherRedemptionType.description: Voucher redemption option required by the scenario.

voucherType.description: Optional voucher product substring required when selecting the loyalty fixture.

exactVoucherCount.description: Require the selected loyalty fixture to contain exactly this many eligible vouchers.

expectedAppliedVoucherCount.description: Require the selected redemption option to apply exactly this many vouchers.

requireAllVouchersMatchType.description: Require every stored voucher on the selected fixture to match voucherType.

voucherMinimumPoints.description: Minimum points balance required when selecting the voucher-backed loyalty fixture.
